rationale:
Assessed minor compatibility impact from v1.2.0; pre-production minor bump: 1.2.0 → 1.3.0.

- Web: Home now links to the existing privacy overview; the Overview item leaves the main navigation. The /overview route and its content remain available. Evidence: apps/web/src/features/overview/HomeSurface.tsx, apps/web/src/shell/AppNav.tsx, docs/adr/0029-authenticated-home-is-chat-first-and-overview-remains-a-separate-route.md, and e2e/web-smoke.spec.ts.
- HTTP: documented routes, request/response contracts, accepted fields and client behavior are unchanged. The Home and overview views continue to share the existing /v1/overview request; the candidate diff contains no API or shared-contract change.
- MCP: tool names, schemas, aliases and protocol behavior are unchanged; the candidate diff contains no MCP code or contract change.
- Identity/OAuth: login, sessions, tokens, grants, refresh and revocation behavior are unchanged; the candidate diff contains no auth or OAuth change.
- Authority: app permissions, disclosure approvals and processing provider choices are unchanged. The new link reveals only the existing overview to its authenticated owner.
- Data: no schema, migration, export/import or persistence change; existing data is preserved. No migration is needed from 1.2.0, and rollback can use matching 1.2.0 images without a data restore for this release.
- Deployment: image/service names, routes, runtime requirements and environment variables are unchanged. Update matching API/worker, web and MCP images to 1.3.0 together. The existing privacy overview is now reached from Home rather than the main navigation.

The candidate includes only the merged Home/overview navigation PR #18 after the 1.2.0 release synchronization. The feature adds a supported navigation path and keeps the existing route available, so it is a minor addition under the pre-production policy.
